items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Patty Harmon kept the band intact, because when we'd go to the pier anyhow

ctx.x: How many pieces in Charlie Elgar's band?

Well, we had at that time... 22. 22 pieces. Yeah. Patty Harmon kept the band intact, because when we'd go to the pier anyhow, we'd play the plan, park plan dances, out of the Municipal Pier, which is a Navy pier now. Every Memorial Day, which was Decoration Day, we'd go out to the pier. They'd open up, and they'd stay open until Labor Day.
How much money were you making with that band?
